heading: Political activities
lead: The corporation shall be nonpolitical and may not promote the candidacy of an individual seeking public office.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2170636:46.Sept. 16, 1919, ch. 59, § 6, 41 Stat. 285. The words “as an organization” are omitted as unnecessary.
